**What.** The owner ruled one history: everything pulls from the same history. The years before the start are still partly generated by buildDeepPast and past-family, while the history lead replaces them kind by kind with simulated records. Nothing stops a new reader from reading a generated kind, or an old reader from staying on it after its simulated replacement lands.

**Rules.** Replace, never layer: a generated kind is listed with its writer, its readers only shrink, and once simulatedBy names the simulated kind every reader of the proxy fails until it moves. One engine per mechanic: one history, one writer per kind of past.

**Done when.** tests/guards/one-history.test.ts with tests/guards/one-history-proxies.json lists the twelve generated kinds from deep-past and past-family and their four reading files; the test run passes on main, fails when a new file reads a generated kind, and fails for executive, conversation and speech-builder when work:tenure-summary gets a simulatedBy.

**Files.** tests/guards/one-history.test.ts, tests/guards/one-history-proxies.json, scripts/guards/index.ts
